notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.20.3
Big update to Stacking Suite: When you click on Register and Integrate OR Skip Registration and integrate, it will look to see if there are previously aligned files in the stacking directory and ask if you want to reuse them so you dont have to re-register your images and this also means if you click Skip Registration and Integrate, even if the file list is only the calibrated files it will ask, Found all these Registered images, use these instead? Also improved Scoring and Weighting and bug fixes.

Update to Surface Mosaic tool to parallize the process, gradient tile matching, and introduce much stronger local warping features under the hood.
